component.name: Gatepath
component.summary: Captive-portal handler that protects your other apps

description.p: Gatepath signs you in to captive Wi-Fi networks (hotels, airports, conference venues). When the optional host netns helper is installed, traffic from the sign-in page is isolated to the captive interface without exposing other running apps to the captive gateway. Without that helper, including on Flatpak-only installs, the sign-in page uses the normal host route and Gatepath warns about active VPNs.

ul.li: Uses kernel-enforced network isolation when the host netns helper is available
Loads the sign-in page in an ephemeral WebKit view
Observes and records off-origin navigation and tracker-resource requests without blocking them
Writes a structured audit log of every session

description.p: Adds optional kernel-enforced network-namespace isolation through the host helper, plus refined session diagnostics and audit logging.
Off-origin navigation and tracker-resource requests are now explicitly observed and recorded rather than blocked, preserving compatibility with captive portals.
